seo.title: LUMI — The light beside you, with hands.
seo.description: LUMI is the first AI companion that doesn't just answer — it walks the last mile with you. Lumi (Latin: lux, light) by Infinity Agentic.

hero.title: The light beside you—now with hands.
hero.desc: Lumi (Latin: lux, light)—the first AI companion that doesn't just answer, but walks the last mile with you.

stuck.label: Why LUMI
stuck.title: The third kind of stuck.
stuck.quote: “I already have the answer. I still don't know how to do it.”
stuck.body_p1: Your mom calls about a new app. She isn't slow, and she isn't unwilling — she's stuck on the invisible wall between knowing and doing.
stuck.body_p2: AI gave her the answer. Nobody walked her through.
stuck.tagline: LUMI is the first AI built for the last mile — the part where you actually have to do the thing.

pain.title: How big is this gap?
pain.subtitle: More people are stuck after the answer than you think.
pain.i1_desc: They got the answer. They still don't know step one.
pain.i2_desc: Curious about technology, afraid to ask, afraid to try.
pain.i3_desc: From a leaky faucet to a router setup — every task is a relearn.
pain.i4_label: of customer-service issues need a human
pain.i4_desc: AI can answer. It can't walk the customer through the doing.

steps.title: How LUMI walks with you
steps.subtitle: Three steps that turn AI from an answer-machine into a companion.
steps.s1_desc: LUMI sees your screen and reads the moment. You don't have to explain.
steps.s2_desc: Not a wall of text — step-by-step, gentle prompts, real confirmation.
steps.s3_desc: From step one to done, you're not alone for a single click.

roadmap.title: Where we're going
roadmap.subtitle: LUMI is the start, not the end.
roadmap.c_caption: From screen, into space, into immersion.
roadmap.v1_desc: Shipping this year. The first product — closing the last mile on screen.
roadmap.v2_desc: From the screen into the space around you.
roadmap.v3_desc: From watching to fully immersive learning and training.
roadmap.v4_desc: License the LUMI engine — for support, training, and brand IP.

flywheel.title: Why this keeps compounding
flywheel.subtitle: Two revenue lines × a behavior-data flywheel — the more we walk with people, the smarter we get.
flywheel.i1_desc: Personal and family plans. Companionship beats one-shot tools on retention.
flywheel.i2_desc: Every walked-through task builds a first-of-its-kind dataset of how humans actually do things.
flywheel.i3_desc: Lumi the character — from pixels to plush, animation, and partnerships.

for_business.title: We're open for business too
for_business.subtitle: If your customers, employees, or students get stuck on the last mile, the LUMI engine is licensable. Platform, partner program, and SDK are still here.

closing.title: Do you believe in light?
closing.subtitle: LUMI is shipping soon. We pick our early users carefully.
